entities.summary: The Hamad Bin Khalifa Civilisation Center, abbreviated as HBKCC, also called the Grand Mosque of Copenhagen, is a mosque in the Outer Nørrebro borough of Copenhagen, Denmark. Built in 2014, it is one of the largest mosques in Europe.
